  • Method Details

    • addType

      void addType(SootClass sootClass)
      Adds the type to the hierarchy, updating all structures to reflect its presence as if it had been a member of the hierarchy from the beginning.

      For internal use only.

    • updateType

      void updateType(SootClass sootClass)
      Notifies the hierarchy that the class of a type it already contains was replaced by a class with the same superclass and interfaces, e.g. because a method was added. The hierarchy itself does not change, but cached class objects must not be returned anymore.

      For internal use only.

    • removeType

      void removeType(ClassType type)
      Removes the declaration of the given type, e.g. because its class was removed from the view. The hierarchy then answers like one built without that class: a type that other types still name as their superclass or interface remains as such a reference, any other type is gone.

      For internal use only.
